title: Formula engine core: tokenizer, parser, references, dependency graph, incremental evaluator
task:
Implement §3.4 except the bulk function library. Tokenizer and Pratt parser for the full Excel grammar (A1/R1C1 parse-only for R1C1 in this WP, absolute/mixed refs, sheet-qualified and quoted sheet names, 3-D ranges, whole rows/columns, structured references with [#All]/[#Headers]/[#Data]/[#Totals]/[@Col]/[@] and column ranges, defined names, array constants, operators with Excel precedence (including unary minus before %, and `^` left-assoc as Excel), string/number/boolean/error literals, whitespace-as-intersection, union with comma inside parentheses, implicit intersection `@`, function calls with empty args). AST with source spans (for syntax highlighting + the Formula Lab). Reference canonicalisation and shifting (`moveFormula`, insert/delete rows/cols adjusting refs, copy with relative adjustment, `#REF!` on deletion), A1<->R1C1 conversion, absolute toggling (F4 cycle). Value model with ErrorValue, Array2D, Blank, Lambda; coercion rules (text->number per Excel incl. percentages, dates in text in en-US, booleans), comparison rules (text case-insensitive, type ordering number<text<boolean), Excel-style 15-significant-digit normalisation, date serial helpers (1900 with the Lotus bug, 1904 option). Evaluator with lazy arguments (annotate function descriptors with `lazy: [indices]`), dynamic arrays (spill area computation, `#SPILL!` on collisions, `#` spill-range operator), implicit intersection for legacy contexts, array lifting for scalar functions over arrays, volatile marking, LET/LAMBDA/MAP/REDUCE/SCAN/BYROW/BYCOL/MAKEARRAY semantics (these core functions are implemented here; the rest come in WP-09). `DependencyGraph`: cell and range nodes, interval tree per sheet so a range precedent is one edge, dirty propagation, Kahn topological recalculation of dirty subgraph, cycle detection with `#CIRCULAR` (represented as Excel's 0 + circular-reference flag), iterative calculation option (max iterations, max change). `Engine` API: `setCell(sheet,row,col, {formula?|value?})`, `insertRows/Cols`, `deleteRows/Cols`, `renameSheet`, `defineName`, `recalc()` (incremental) and `recalcAll()`, `getValue`, `getSpillRange`, `explain(formula) -> step tree` (for Formula Lab), host interface for reading cell values/types so the engine does not own storage.
